fusions.name: Frostbound Blow
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 18 damage, stuns the target for 1.4 seconds, leaves it [Frostbite] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and [Damped] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Unmoving Toll
fusions.desc: Strikes every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 34 damage that ignores resistances, and leaves each [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Deep Freeze
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 2.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Rime Bulwark
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 14%, and you have 8% frost resistance.
